Direction A · Counsel

Components and states

Every interactive element in the Counsel direction, shown in each state. Hover, active and focus are forced here so they can be compared side by side.

Color

Warm paper, blue-black ink, the logo blue and one sparing brass accent. Every text and UI pairing is declared with @pair in tokens.css and passes WCAG AA.

Paper --neutral-50
Linen --neutral-100
Card --card-white
Sunken --neutral-200
Rule --neutral-300
Slate --neutral-600
Ink --neutral-900
Tint --brand-100
Logo blue --brand-500
Counsel blue --brand-600
Navy --brand-700
Brass --accent-600

Type

Newsreader (display, optical sizes) with Public Sans (text). Fluid 1.25 scale.

Eyebrow · small caps, tracked 0.08em

Criminal defense

Questions people ask first

Is the first consultation free?

Lead: Will Fraley, Attorney at Law, defends people in criminal court.

Body: Call (615) 410-7290 for a free consultation. Text links are Counsel blue with a 1.5 px underline at 0.2em offset.

Fine print: Prior results do not guarantee a similar outcome.
